purpose: Immune-system reads: cynic observes every fleet substrate signal (data OS) while mutating nothing. Read-only capabilities only; each re-run is a no-op. Merge into infra/capabilities/catalog.json when it is free (foreign edit in flight at proposal time — do NOT overwrite). Binary paths marked VERIFY were not ls-proven on targets; run ls -la per node before install (new content = new proposal if a path differs).

capabilities.purpose: read WireGuard handshake timestamps for overlay liveness (read-only)
capabilities.risk_note: abuser reads handshake timestamps and peer keys (already public to any root); cannot change peers, cannot exfiltrate traffic; no shell, no wildcard

capabilities.purpose: identify owners of listening sockets to close phantom listeners (read-only)
capabilities.binary_verify: VERIFY:/bin/ss vs /usr/bin/ss per node (distinct files possible)
capabilities.risk_note: abuser lists listening ports and owning PIDs (visible to any root); cannot bind, kill, or connect; no shell, fixed argv, zero params

capabilities.purpose: read the live firewall ruleset for audit against declared policy (read-only)
capabilities.binary_verify: VERIFY:/usr/sbin/nft per node; PVE has no nft binary observed — iptables-legacy fallback TBD as separate proposal, never assumed
capabilities.risk_note: abuser reads packet-filter rules (visible to any root); cannot add, flush, or disable rules; no shell, fixed argv

capabilities.purpose: prove time sync state (certs, handshakes, dated proofs depend on it)
capabilities.binary_verify: VERIFY:/bin/timedatectl per node; usually unprivileged — drop requires_root if proven
capabilities.risk_note: abuser reads clock state; no mutation surface at all

install: existing surfaces only (no new helper, no new sudoers generator): stage via cynic-host-exec pve-helper-bundle or the installed cynic binary capability path; HumanAdmin installs projected artifacts once (install -m + visudo -c BEFORE install); capability growth afterwards needs no new privilege decision for this read-only class.
read_back: sudo -n -l on each node shows exactly the granted argv; then live probes (wg dump, ss -tlnp, nft list ruleset, timedatectl show) move NET-09/10/11/12 to observed. Record references in infra/privilege-grants.json (proposed -> installed).
non_goals: pct-list/pct-status already in catalog (reuse, never redeclare); no CT file reads beyond existing forgejo-inspect pattern; no DNS writes, no restarts, no package installs in this proposal.
